stories.title: Cardinals name Minshew as starter, move Brissett to QB3
stories.summary: The Cardinals named Gardner Minshew as the team's new starting QB while moving Jacoby Brissett below rookie Carson Beck on the depth chart.

stories.title: Sirianni: No changes at OC or QB despite Eagles' 6-game skid
stories.summary: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that he is not making a change at offensive coordinator or quarterback amid his team's six-game losing streak.

stories.title: Packers sticking with RB Jacobs despite latest abuse allegations
stories.summary: Packers coach Matt LaFleur says the team is sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite new allegations of abuse levied by multiple women in addition to a May incident that led to his arrest.

stories.title: WR Aiyuk hires Rosenhaus as agent, eyes return to NFL
stories.summary: Brandon Aiyuk has hired agent Drew Rosenhaus, who told ESPN's Adam Schefter that he is "working on getting him back to work and playing again in the NFL."

stories.title: Watkins scores 21 as USC celebrates return: 'The game is just better with her in it'
stories.summary: JuJu Watkins spent last season supporting her USC teammates while working toward her own return. Monday, they finally got to celebrate with her on the court.
